camps.description_short: An enrichment day camp at Iona University in New Rochelle for ages 4 to 15. camps.name: Trailside Nature Camp
camps.street_address: Ward Pound Ridge Reservation, Route 35 and 121 South
camps.description_short: County nature camp at the Trailside Nature Museum in Ward Pound Ridge Reservation, Westchester's largest park, for Pre-K to 9th grade. One week sessions, 9 to 3, explore the reservation with visits to archaeological sites, crayfish catching, nature games and art; Pre-K mornings only, and two week sessions for grades 7 to 9 with an optional campout.
camps.notes: Prices shown are for non-Westchester residents ($425 a week). County residents pay $375 a week. Pre-K mornings are $200 a week and the grades 7 to 9 two week sessions $775 for everyone. Campers may attend at most three weeks.

camps.name: Westchester Summer Day
camps.description_short: Day camp of Westchester Day School on Long Island Sound in Mamaroneck for children from age 3 to 8th grade, rooted in Jewish values, with swim, beach, a ropes course, sports, arts, cooking and music. Campers in 5th to 8th grade pick an active or creative track each week and take day and overnight trips. Kosher lunch and snacks are included; busing costs extra.

sessions.name: Full summer, full day (pre-nursery 3s to 8th grade)

camps.notes: 2027 standard full day rates: 5 weeks $6,250, 6 weeks $6,650, 7 weeks $6,900, full summer $7,100. Westchester Day School students pay less ($5,500 to $6,400). Half day for 3 year olds $5,250 to $6,100. The full summer session runs June 28 to August 18; shorter options are chosen within it.

camps.name: Westchester County Summer Programs (YMCA of Central and Northern Westchester)
camps.operator_name: YMCA of Central and Northern Westchester
camps.description_short: Six week YMCA summer day program for children entering grades 1 to 5 (Big Kid Summer), held at the White Plains YMCA and in Valhalla, with weekly themes, sports, science lessons, special visitors and field trips. A Pee Wee program for the Y's own UPK students also runs at these sites and at French Hill School in Yorktown Heights.
camps.notes: Weekly rate $440 for 8 am to 4 pm, $480 for 8 am to 6 pm. Locations: White Plains YMCA, 148 Hamilton Ave (Pee Wee and Big Kid); 2 Broadway, Valhalla (Pee Wee and Big Kid); French Hill School, 2051 Baldwin Rd, Yorktown Heights (Pee Wee only, for Yorktown, Lakeland, Mahopac, North Salem, Putnam Valley and Somers families). Pee Wee Summer is only for YMCA UPK students of the 2025 to 2026 or 2026 to 2027 school years.

camps.name: YMCA of Yonkers Summer Camp
camps.description_short: Full day YMCA summer camp at the Yonkers Y on Riverdale Avenue for kids ages 5 to 14 (kindergarten to grade 7), with sports, STEAM, arts, dance and drumming, summer learning and field trips. Families sign up by the week.
camps.notes: Standard weekly cost $325, plus a $50 application fee; 10% sibling discount. Hours 7:30 am to 6 pm, Monday to Friday. Families applying through DSS should contact the camp. Meals and snacks are included.
